title: Size of the unfolded circuit
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean directed acyclic circuit whose gates have pairwise distinct input vertices and whose NOT gates each have exactly one input. If every gate has at most $k$ input vertices, then the size of the tree obtained by unfolding $C$ is at most $(k+1)^{	ext{depth}(C)}$.
hypotheses_covered: Every gate has pairwise distinct input vertices
Every NOT gate has exactly one input
A natural number $k$ bounds the number of input vertices of every gate
